exposure: sustained inflation (SI) followed by intermittent positive pressure ventilation (IPPV)
outcome: rate and uniformity of lung aeration
cohort: Newborn New Zealand white rabbit kittens, some with an induced left-sided congenital diaphragmatic hernia (DH) and litter mates as controls.
finding: An initial sustained inflation (SI) increased the rate and uniformity of lung aeration in DH kittens and increased dynamic lung compliance in both control and DH kittens compared to IPPV, but this benefit was lost after switching to IPPV.
gest_age: Induced at 24 days gestation (term 32 days), delivered at 30 days gestation
